name: raksul-catalog
description: Render a database-backed mock storefront inside ChatGPT with local sign-in, cart, and simulated checkout.

interface.shortDescription: Use an embedded database mock storefront.
interface.longDescription: An embedded MCP App using only the local PostgreSQL product snapshot, with mock sign-in, session-owned carts, and explicit approve-or-reject simulated payments. Never opens the supplier website.
defaultPrompt: Render the embedded RAKSUL database storefront here. Do not open any external website.
Use the RAKSUL mini-app to mock-sign-in and browse products from PostgreSQL.
Help me build a mock cart, then ask me explicitly before approving or rejecting payment.
